summary: Frontend Coding Agent implemented the full production code for NFR-REL-001 (Auto-Save Crash Durability). 7 files created/modified: dbSchema.ts (IndexedDB schema + idb typed helper), persistenceService.ts (atomic dual-store writes, closeSession, purge), crashRecoveryService.ts (boot-time orphan detection with validation), persistenceStore.ts (Zustand state management), useAutoSave.ts (extended with beforeunload + interval), ResumePrompt.tsx (accessible modal with all data-testid attributes), and ResumePrompt/index.ts (barrel export). All implementations satisfy the 10 TDD test contracts from the frontend-test agent.

artifacts.name: IndexedDB Schema
artifacts.description: Database schema types, PersistenceError class, and idb-based DB open helper with upgrade logic

artifacts.name: Persistence Service
artifacts.description: Atomic dual-store writes (saveSnapshot), closeSession, getSnapshot, purgeOldSnapshots, purgeSession

artifacts.name: Crash Recovery Service
artifacts.description: Boot-time crash detection (detectCrash), snapshot validation, restoreSession, discardRecovery

artifacts.name: Persistence Store
artifacts.description: Zustand store managing auto-save status, session lifecycle, and crash recovery UI state

artifacts.name: useAutoSave Hook
artifacts.description: Extended hook with beforeunload listener for graceful close and interval-based auto-save

artifacts.name: ResumePrompt Component
artifacts.description: Accessible modal dialog with role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby, and all required data-testid attributes
